question: What becomes of men lacking faith in this dharma?
premises: Men without faith in this dharma do not attain me.
They turn back on the path of death and saṃsāra.
They are born again and again and die.
inference: Lack of faith in this dharma prevents attainment of me and perpetuates cyclic death and rebirth.
uncertainties: The supplied gloss fuses nivartante and punaḥ punar jāyante; their exact syntactic relation is uncertain.
The verse numbering and whether all supplied tokens belong to one verse are uncertain.
plain_english: Men without faith in this dharma, O scorcher of foes, do not attain me; they turn back on the path of death and saṃsāra, being born again and again and dying.
